facts.business: Julien Agro Infratech Limited operates in the agricultural sector, focusing on agro-infrastructure and related activities.
key_risks: High inflation leading to high policy rates and rise in lending rates
Deficient and unevenly distributed rainfall affecting foodgrains production
Depleting reservoir levels (36% of full capacity as of March 2026)
Decline in output of major crops including rice, pulses, oilseeds, cotton and sugarcane
